description: Ministry of Finance - Amending the Rules made by the Sri Lanka Railway Uniform Staff Benevolent Fund published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 305 of 06.07.1984
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to the rules of the Sri Lanka Railway Uniform Staff Benevolent Fund under the Railway Uniform Staff Benevolent Fund Ordinance. It deals with regulatory modifications to loan amounts, interest rates, and repayment terms, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
